summary: Full E2E testing of Pricing Rules Engine — backend CRUD/simulate/evaluate/formula/audit/meta + quote integration (motor/pa/travel) + frontend 5-tab admin UI. 18/18 pytest tests pass. All five UI tabs render, Simulator real-time recompute verified (RM 10k → RM 12k with +20% rule applied), Audit Logs populated, sidebar nav highlighted correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: pricing_rules.py (~500 lines) is a bit large — could be split into router + evaluator + schemas modules for maintainability, but still acceptable.
PricingRulesEngine.jsx is a single-file UI with five tabs. Consider splitting each tab into its own component file for easier maintenance.
evaluate_rules() catches broad `except Exception` during condition evaluation — ok for resilience but should log the error server-side for observability.

The `fields_by_product` catalogue in /rules/meta/fields is hard-coded and must stay manually in sync with the real rule_inputs dicts inside each /quotes/* endpoint. Refactor to a shared module to avoid drift.
action.value is typed as float but UI sends strings; Pydantic coerces — acceptable but explicit number handling in UI would be cleaner.
seed_data_creation: Tests create & clean up TEST_-prefixed rules via fixtures. One 'Young Driver Surcharge' rule remains if the session fixture ran standalone — auto-cleaned by teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The backend test file `/app/backend/tests/test_pricing_rules.py` covers the full Rules Engine feature (CRUD, toggle, clone, simulate, evaluate, formula config+history, audit logs, meta fields, and motor/pa/travel quote integration). Login endpoint returns token under the key `token` (NOT `access_token`). Motor quote requires `account_type: 'personal'|'business'`, `email`, `full_name`, `id_number`, `postcode`, `date_of_birth` in YYYY-MM-DD. Travel quote requires `accept_privacy:true` + start/end dates. Simulator uses `rule_ids` override to isolate specific rules. Frontend admin route `/admin/rules` with all data-testid hooks verified working.
frontend_test_notes: Login with admin, navigate to /admin/rules. All 5 tabs (Rules, Editor, Simulator, Formula, Audit Logs) render. Simulator recomputes in real-time on input change (verified age=22, vehicle_type=car → RM12000 from RM10000 base with 1 applied rule). Audit logs populate after backend evaluate calls.
